Clifford Torus

Clifford Torus is a topological surface, given by a parametrisation, genus 1, immersed.

Definition

the CIRCLE preset at its default mean colatitude of 90 degrees, i.e. the Hopf preimage of a great circle -- the Clifford torus S1(1/sqrt 2) x S1(1/sqrt 2) in S^3 -- stereographically projected to a torus of revolution; same builder normalisation (and fit) as hopf-torus
